full_judgment: 4. Mr. Mohammad Ismail, the learned Advocate for the respondent Nos. 4 and 5 has argued that though there is no provision in the Pourashava Ordinance regarding removal of Panel Chairman, such power is implied. He has argued that as the Commissioners of the Pourashava to elect Panel of Chairman they are also empowered to remove any such Chairman. Moreover, he has submitted that a special meeting of the Pourashava was convened under the signature of the present petitioner for the purpose of electing a fresh Panel of Chairman and the meeting was held on 22.10.2001 which was presided over by the present petitioner and in his presence the resolution was taken by the Commissioners and Mr. Abul Hossain Bhulu was appointed Panel Chairman No. 1 along with two others as members of that Panel. He has further submitted that the present petitioner also contested but as he was not elected he has filed the present writ petition. According to him he is estopped from challenging the election of Abul Hossain Dhulu as Panel Chairman No. 1 because that election was held in his presence and he also participated in the election. Mr. Mohammad Ismail has cited the case of Rayabappan versus Madhabi Amma as reported in 1950 AIR (F.C) page 140 in support of his views.
